name: Temporary Residence as Migrant Worker

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a signed pre-contract specifying personal data, tasks, work hours, duration, workplace, and compensation aligned with the applicable collective bargaining agreement, plus the employer's CUIT.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a qualifying job offer from an Argentine employer.

requirements.blocker_text: The employer must hold an active AFIP (tax authority) registration certificate and be registered in the Migration Directorate's foreign-contractor registry.
Requires an Argentine criminal background certificate and foreign criminal records from any country resided in for 1+ years during the past 3 years (applicants 16+).

evidence_required.document: Employer's AFIP registration certificate and foreign-contractor registry enrollment
Criminal background certificates (Argentina and relevant foreign countries)
Proof of address and regular income

sources.title: Dirección Nacional de Migraciones -- Obtener una residencia temporaria como trabajador migrante: employment pre-contract, employer AFIP/migration registry requirements, 1-year duration, RaDEX process

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Argentina). pr_after_months (36) reflects the non-MERCOSUR permanent-residence threshold of 3 years of valid temporary residence (see ar_permanent_residence.json) -- non-MERCOSUR nationals on this work route need the longer 3-year path, vs. 2 years for MERCOSUR nationals on the same underlying route. citizenship_after_months (60) reflects Argentina's unusually short standard naturalization bar: 2 CONTINUOUS years of legal residence (Ley 346 Article 2) is the naturalization requirement itself, not counted from PR -- modeled here as 60 months as a practical illustrative total (roughly 3 years to reach PR eligibility as a non-MERCOSUR worker, though naturalization's own 2-year clock can in principle run in parallel on temporary residence alone since Ley 346 does not require permanent residence specifically, only 2 years of continuous LEGAL residence) -- see ar_naturalisation.json for the precise, much shorter standalone figure. This chained estimate is a conservative illustrative combination, not what the law itself states as a single number.
